Substitution of section 11 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.1 of 1996

NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCEFINANCE
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCEFINANCE
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2003
ORDINANCE IV OF 2003
An Ordinance
further to amend the
North-West
Frontier Province Finance Act, 1996
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, dated 11th April, 2003]
No.LEGIS.1(14)/73/2692, dated
11-4-2003.---The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:--
2. Substitution of section 11
of N.-W.F.P. Act No.1 of 1996.--In the North-West Frontier Province Finance
Act, 1996 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. 1 of 1996), for section 11 of the following shall
be substituted, namely:--
"Tobacco
development cess.--(1) There shall be levied and collected development cess on
tobacco at the rate of two rupees per kilogram from--
(a) tobacco
manufacturing factories on the basis of quota fixed for the factory concerned
by the Pakistan Tobacco Board; and
(b) persons,
other than tobacco factories, dealing in tobacco business, who are transporting
tobacco outside the district of its production:
Provided that
tobacco factories shall not be liable to pay the cess on tobacco on which cess
has already been paid under clause (b):
Provided further
that no cess shall be charged on the tobacco being transported, for which cess
has already been paid under clause (a).
(2) The cess for tobacco for the
period from 1-7-1997 to 30-6-1998 (both days inclusive), recovered at the rate
of Rs. 1.2 per K. G. shall, for all intents and purposes, be deemed to have
been validly recovered, as if the said rate were fixed under this Act.
(3) The proceeds
of the cess shall be utilized, for--
(i) special
maintenance and development of roads, highways and special plant protection
service in the tobacco growing areas in the Province.
(ii) such
activities as Are directed towards the development of tobacco production in the
Province; and
(iii)
maintenance and development of infrastructure in the Province in such manner as
may be prescribed.".
